subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should this issue be resolved by the broader channel repair, the narrower group-chat opt-in fallback, or a combined Microsoft Teams inbound-media PR?
rationale: Current main still fails, but the safe landing shape affects Graph call volume, operator config, permissions expectations, and whether channel URL fixes are bundled with the group-chat fallback.

options.title: Keep the canonical channel repair as primary
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738 for the channel team-GUID and reply-URL defects, while treating https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101096 as a separate group-chat-only opt-in if maintainers want that narrower behavior.

options.title: Combine both fixes
options.body: Ask one branch to cover channel URL construction, channel fallback triggering, and group-chat stripped-HTML fallback before this issue can close.

options.title: Require opt-in fallback everywhere
options.body: Pause the no-config channel fallback and require any extra Graph media lookup to be behind a documented Microsoft Teams setting.

recommendation.title: Keep the canonical channel repair as primary
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738 for the channel team-GUID and reply-URL defects, while treating https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101096 as a separate group-chat-only opt-in if maintainers want that narrower behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is a Microsoft Teams plugin config/default policy decision, and history shows the strongest central-file ownership signal for this person.
